import Mathlib

/-! ### Precondition definitions -/

def solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  (weights.length = values.length) ∧
  (weights.length > 0) ∧
  (capacity ≤ 1000) ∧
  (∀ i, i < weights.length → weights.getD i 0 > 0) ∧
  (∀ i, i < weights.length → weights.getD i 0 ≤ 1000) ∧
  (∀ i, i < values.length → values.getD i 0 ≤ 1000)

/-! ### Auxiliary definitions for the post‑condition -/

def list_nat_to_int (l : List Nat) : List Int :=
  l.map (fun x => Int.ofNat x)

def total_weight (counts weights : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip weights).foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) 0

def total_value (counts values : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip values).foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) 0

def is_valid_strategy (counts weights : List Int) (capacity : Int) : Prop :=
  counts.length = weights.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 ≥ 0) ∧
  total_weight counts weights ≤ capacity

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Recursive dot product of two integer lists (truncating at the shorter one). -/
def dotp : List Int → List Int → Int
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | a :: as, b :: bs => a * b + dotp as bs

/-- The unbounded knapsack DP.  We use `weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1` as the weight of
item `i`, which coincides with `weights.getD i 0` whenever the weight is positive
(guaranteed by the precondition) and which is always `≥ 1`, making termination easy. -/
def bestVal (weights values : List Nat) (cap : Nat) : Nat :=
  match cap with
  | 0 => 0
  | c + 1 =>
      ((List.range weights.length).map (fun i =>
        if weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 ≤ c + 1 then
          values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c + 1 - (weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1))
        else 0)).foldr max 0
  termination_by cap
  decreasing_by omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def solve_knapsack_unbounded
    (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond weights values capacity) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bestVal weights values capacity
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
def solve_knapsack_unbounded_postcond
    (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) (result : Nat)
    (h_precond : solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond weights values capacity) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ counts : List Int,
        is_valid_strategy counts (list_nat_to_int weights) (Int.ofNat capacity) →
        total_value counts (list_nat_to_int values) ≤ Int.ofNat result) ∧
  (∃ counts : List Int,
        is_valid_strategy counts (list_nat_to_int weights) (Int.ofNat capacity) ∧
        total_value counts (list_nat_to_int values) = Int.ofNat result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### Basic lemmas about `dotp` -/

theorem foldl_zip_eq (as bs : List Int) (acc : Int) :
    (as.zip bs).foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) acc = acc + dotp as bs := by
  induction as generalizing bs acc with
  | nil => cases bs <;> simp [dotp]
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [dotp]
    | cons b bs =>
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.foldl_cons, dotp, ih]
      ring

theorem total_weight_eq (counts weights : List Int) :
    total_weight counts weights = dotp counts weights := by
  simp [total_weight, foldl_zip_eq]

theorem total_value_eq (counts values : List Int) :
    total_value counts values = dotp counts values := by
  simp [total_value, foldl_zip_eq]

theorem getD_list_nat_to_int (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (list_nat_to_int l).getD i 0 = ((l.getD i 0 : Nat) : Int) := by
  unfold list_nat_to_int
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => simpa using ih j

theorem length_list_nat_to_int (l : List Nat) :
    (list_nat_to_int l).length = l.length := by
  simp [list_nat_to_int]

theorem getD_set_eq (l : List Int) (i : Nat) (v : Int) (h : i < l.length) :
    (l.set i v).getD i 0 = v := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j =>
      have h' : j < t.length := by simpa using h
      simpa using ih j h'

theorem getD_set_ne (l : List Int) (i j : Nat) (v : Int) (h : j ≠ i) :
    (l.set i v).getD j 0 = l.getD j 0 := by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      cases j with
      | zero => exact absurd rfl h
      | succ k => simp
    | succ m =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
        have h' : k ≠ m := by omega
        simpa using ih m k h'

theorem dotp_set : ∀ (as bs : List Int) (i : Nat) (v : Int), i < as.length →
    dotp (as.set i v) bs = dotp as bs + (v - as.getD i 0) * bs.getD i 0 := by
  intro as
  induction as with
  | nil => intro bs i v h; simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro bs i v h
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp [dotp]
      | cons b bs =>
        show dotp (v :: as) (b :: bs) = dotp (a :: as) (b :: bs) + (v - a) * b
        simp only [dotp]
        ring
    | succ j =>
      have h' : j < as.length := by simpa using h
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp [dotp]
      | cons b bs =>
        have hih : dotp (as.set j v) bs = dotp as bs + (v - as.getD j 0) * bs.getD j 0 :=
          ih bs j v h'
        show dotp (a :: as.set j v) (b :: bs)
            = dotp (a :: as) (b :: bs) + (v - as.getD j 0) * bs.getD j 0
        simp only [dotp, hih]
        ring

theorem dotp_nonneg : ∀ (as bs : List Int),
    (∀ i, i < as.length → 0 ≤ as.getD i 0) →
    (∀ i, i < bs.length → 0 ≤ bs.getD i 0) → 0 ≤ dotp as bs := by
  intro as
  induction as with
  | nil => intro bs _ _; simp [dotp]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro bs ha hb
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [dotp]
    | cons b bs =>
      have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
        have := ha 0 (by simp)
        simpa using this
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
        have := hb 0 (by simp)
        simpa using this
      have ha' : ∀ i, i < as.length → 0 ≤ as.getD i 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have := ha (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
        simpa using this
      have hb' : ∀ i, i < bs.length → 0 ≤ bs.getD i 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have := hb (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
        simpa using this
      have h2 := ih bs ha' hb'
      have h3 : 0 ≤ a * b := mul_nonneg ha0 hb0
      show 0 ≤ a * b + dotp as bs
      linarith

theorem dotp_eq_zero_of_all_zero : ∀ (as bs : List Int),
    (∀ i, i < as.length → as.getD i 0 = 0) → dotp as bs = 0 := by
  intro as
  induction as with
  | nil => intro bs _; simp [dotp]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro bs ha
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [dotp]
    | cons b bs =>
      have ha0 : a = 0 := by
        have := ha 0 (by simp)
        simpa using this
      have ha' : ∀ i, i < as.length → as.getD i 0 = 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have := ha (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
        simpa using this
      have h2 := ih bs ha'
      show a * b + dotp as bs = 0
      rw [ha0, h2]
      ring

theorem dotp_replicate_zero : ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List Int),
    dotp (List.replicate n 0) bs = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro bs; simp [dotp]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro bs
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [List.replicate_succ, dotp]
    | cons b bs =>
      have h2 := ih bs
      show dotp ((0 : Int) :: List.replicate m 0) (b :: bs) = 0
      simp only [dotp, h2]
      ring

theorem getD_replicate_zero : ∀ (n i : Nat), (List.replicate n (0:Int)).getD i 0 = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro i; simp
  | succ m ih =>
    intro i
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [List.replicate_succ]
    | succ j => simpa [List.replicate_succ] using ih j

/-! ### Lemmas about `foldr max` -/

theorem le_foldr_max (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) (h : x ∈ l) : x ≤ l.foldr max 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
    · subst h1
      simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · refine le_trans (ih h1) ?_
      simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      exact le_max_right _ _

theorem foldr_max_zero_or_mem (l : List Nat) :
    l.foldr max 0 = 0 ∨ l.foldr max 0 ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rcases ih with h | h
    · right
      have : (a :: t).foldr max 0 = a := by
        simp only [List.foldr_cons, h, Nat.max_zero]
      rw [this]
      exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
    · rcases max_choice a (t.foldr max 0) with hm | hm
      · right
        have : (a :: t).foldr max 0 = a := by
          simp only [List.foldr_cons, hm]
        rw [this]
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
      · right
        have : (a :: t).foldr max 0 = t.foldr max 0 := by
          simp only [List.foldr_cons, hm]
        rw [this]
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h)

/-! ### Unfolding lemma for `bestVal` -/

theorem bestVal_succ (weights values : List Nat) (c : Nat) :
    bestVal weights values (c + 1) =
      ((List.range weights.length).map (fun i =>
        if weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 ≤ c + 1 then
          values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c + 1 - (weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1))
        else 0)).foldr max 0 := by
  rw [bestVal]

/-- The value of the branch for item `i`, when the weight is positive and fits. -/
theorem branch_eq (weights values : List Nat) (c i : Nat)
    (hw : 0 < weights.getD i 0) (hle : weights.getD i 0 ≤ c + 1) :
    (if weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 ≤ c + 1 then
        values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c + 1 - (weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1))
      else 0)
      = values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c + 1 - weights.getD i 0) := by
  have h1 : weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 = weights.getD i 0 := by omega
  rw [h1, if_pos hle]

/-- If the weight does not fit, the branch value is `0`. -/
theorem branch_eq_zero (weights values : List Nat) (c i : Nat)
    (hw : 0 < weights.getD i 0) (hle : ¬ weights.getD i 0 ≤ c + 1) :
    (if weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 ≤ c + 1 then
        values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c + 1 - (weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1))
      else 0) = 0 := by
  have h1 : weights.getD i 0 - 1 + 1 = weights.getD i 0 := by omega
  rw [h1, if_neg hle]

/-- The DP value dominates every single choice of an item. -/
theorem bestVal_ge (weights values : List Nat) (c i : Nat)
    (hi : i < weights.length) (hw : 0 < weights.getD i 0)
    (hle : weights.getD i 0 ≤ c) :
    values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c - weights.getD i 0)
      ≤ bestVal weights values c := by
  cases c with
  | zero => omega
  | succ c =>
    rw [bestVal_succ]
    apply le_foldr_max
    rw [List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, branch_eq weights values c i hw hle⟩

/-! ### Upper bound -/

theorem best_upper (weights values : List Nat)
    (hpos : ∀ i, i < weights.length → 0 < weights.getD i 0) :
    ∀ c : Nat, ∀ counts : List Int, counts.length = weights.length →
      (∀ i, i < counts.length → 0 ≤ counts.getD i 0) →
      dotp counts (list_nat_to_int weights) ≤ (c : Int) →
      dotp counts (list_nat_to_int values) ≤ (bestVal weights values c : Int) := by
  intro c
  induction c using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ c ih =>
    intro counts hlen hnn hw
    by_cases hz : ∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 = 0
    · rw [dotp_eq_zero_of_all_zero counts _ hz]
      simp
    · push_neg at hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hne⟩ := hz
      have hi' : i < weights.length := by omega
      have hw1 : 0 < weights.getD i 0 := hpos i hi'
      have hci : 1 ≤ counts.getD i 0 := by
        have := hnn i hi
        omega
      have hlen' : (counts.set i (counts.getD i 0 - 1)).length = weights.length := by
        rw [List.length_set, hlen]
      have hnn' : ∀ j, j < (counts.set i (counts.getD i 0 - 1)).length →
          0 ≤ (counts.set i (counts.getD i 0 - 1)).getD j 0 := by
        intro j hj
        rw [List.length_set] at hj
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst hji

          omega
        · rw [getD_set_ne counts i j _ hji]
          exact hnn j hj
      have hWnn : ∀ j, j < (list_nat_to_int weights).length →
          0 ≤ (list_nat_to_int weights).getD j 0 := by
        intro j _
        rw [getD_list_nat_to_int]
        simp
      have hwt : dotp (counts.set i (counts.getD i 0 - 1)) (list_nat_to_int weights)
          = dotp counts (list_nat_to_int weights) - ((weights.getD i 0 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [dotp_set counts _ i _ hi, getD_list_nat_to_int]
        ring
      have hnn0 : 0 ≤ dotp (counts.set i (counts.getD i 0 - 1)) (list_nat_to_int weights) :=
        dotp_nonneg _ _ hnn' hWnn

      have hwcn : weights.getD i 0 ≤ c := by exact_mod_cast hwc

          + (bestVal weights values (c - weights.getD i 0) : Int)
          ≤ (bestVal weights values c : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hA
      rw [hvt]
      linarith

theorem best_exists (weights values : List Nat)
    (hpos : ∀ i, i < weights.length → 0 < weights.getD i 0) :
    ∀ c : Nat, ∃ counts : List Int, counts.length = weights.length ∧
      (∀ i, i < counts.length → 0 ≤ counts.getD i 0) ∧
      dotp counts (list_nat_to_int weights) ≤ (c : Int) ∧
      dotp counts (list_nat_to_int values) = (bestVal weights values c : Int) := by
  intro c
  induction c using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ c ih =>
    have zeros : ∀ d : Nat, bestVal weights values d = 0 →
        ∃ counts : List Int, counts.length = weights.length ∧
          (∀ i, i < counts.length → 0 ≤ counts.getD i 0) ∧
          dotp counts (list_nat_to_int weights) ≤ (d : Int) ∧
          dotp counts (list_nat_to_int values) = (bestVal weights values d : Int) := by
      intro d hd
      refine ⟨List.replicate weights.length 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

      · rw [dotp_replicate_zero]
        simp
      · rw [dotp_replicate_zero, hd]
        simp

      rw [bestVal]

        have hi : i < weights.length := List.mem_range.mp hirange
        have hw1 : 0 < weights.getD i 0 := hpos i hi
        by_cases hle : weights.getD i 0 ≤ c' + 1
        · -- the maximum comes from choosing item `i`
          have hval : bestVal weights values (c' + 1)
              = values.getD i 0 + bestVal weights values (c' + 1 - weights.getD i 0) := by
            rw [bestVal_succ, ← heq]
            exact branch_eq weights values c' i hw1 hle
          obtain ⟨cs, hcslen, hcsnn, hcsw, hcsv⟩ :=
            ih (c' + 1 - weights.getD i 0) (by omega)

          refine ⟨cs.set i (cs.getD i 0 + 1), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [List.length_set, hcslen]
          · intro j hj
            rw [List.length_set] at hj
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst hji
              rw [getD_set_eq cs j _ hics]
              have := hcsnn j hics

          · rw [dotp_set cs _ i _ hics, getD_list_nat_to_int]
            have hcast : ((c' + 1 - weights.getD i 0 : Nat) : Int)

              rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
            rw [hcast] at hcsw
            have : ((c' + 1 : Nat) : Int) = ((c' : Int) + 1) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [this] at hcsw
            push_cast
            linarith
          · rw [dotp_set cs _ i _ hics, getD_list_nat_to_int, hcsv, hval]
            push_cast
            ring

          apply zeros
          rw [bestVal_succ, ← heq]
          exact branch_eq_zero weights values c' i hw1 hle

    (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond weights values capacity) :
    solve_knapsack_unbounded_postcond
      weights values capacity
      (solve_knapsack_unbounded weights values capacity h_precond)
      h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hlen, hgt, hcap, hpos, hle, hvle⟩ := h_precond

    obtain ⟨hclen, hcnn, hcw⟩ := hvalid

    · rw [hclen, length_list_nat_to_int]

    · rw [total_weight_eq]

    · rw [total_value_eq]
